Maria: Quick sync — need to finalize the tool/function-calling API MVP and lock down what counts as launch-ready for Q2. Top asks from customers: JSON Schema args, a stable error contract, sync + opt-in async, compact structured result envelope, streaming for big outputs, per-tool ACLs, and schema versioning. Which of these are must-ships vs nice-to-haves?

Sam: For an MVP I propose we scope to: sync "invoke" with server-side JSON Schema validation, a compact result envelope (status + output + minimal meta), and a tight error enum (INVALID_ARGS, TOOL_ERROR, TIMEOUT, AUTH_DENIED). Fallback: if the tool returns unstructured text, surface it in the envelope body. Keep async opt-in and enterprise-gated for v1 — avoids building durable queue infra immediately.

Jules: Dev DX notes: docs should include auto-generated example request/response per tool and human-friendly validation errors (field path + reason). Ship one-line SDK examples for py/js in the first pass. Also include a tiny snippet showing streaming chunk shape for the future streaming opt-in.

Oliver: From sales: one AE flagged an enterprise customer that needs signed callback URLs + defined retry semantics (idempotency, backoff window). If async is gated behind Dedicated/Enterprise, we should call that out in the launch messaging and sales playbook.

Nina: Security constraints: tool metadata must not allow executable payload fields (no "command"/"exec" string patterns). Enforce RBAC on who can register/modify tools, and require audit logging for all invocations. For hosted mode, add PII scanning/redaction and an opt-out for logging on Private installs.

Ben: Rollout suggestion: feature-flag v1 (default off for existing orgs), canary to 5% of new orgs. Telemetry: schema validation failure rate, median invoke latency, error-class distribution, and percentage of fallback-to-plain-text events. Launch criteria: docs + SDK snippets published, <1% validation failures on top customer prompts, no critical security blockers.

deploy-bot: CI: branch "feature/tool-invoke-mvp" — integration tests: schema validation, sync invoke path, envelope conformance: GREEN.

Sam: Implementation notes: add a "schema_version" string on tool metadata and echo it on the call envelope for evolution. Keep the envelope compact (status code + short message + outputs) for perf-sensitive paths; include an optional verbose/debug field behind a header/flag. Use a small stable error code set and avoid embedding huge nested objects in the core envelope.

Maria: TL;DR action items: (1) Sam to own the API spec draft (sync invoke + JSON Schema args + result envelope + error codes). (2) Jules to produce example snippets & friendly validation UX. (3) Nina to provide security gating checklist & logging controls. (4) Oliver to compile enterprise customer asks that require gating. (5) Ben to define canary telemetry & flagging plan. Review spec on Thurs 11am — drop notes in this thread if you can't make it. :thumbsup:
